note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, the column for Yemen, as the copy gives it. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Release 103 (September 2026) is SWIFT's current; changes since this copy aren't read.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), its text release: the copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (registry.txt, commit 81b6dbcb, 2025-02-18; its latest country update December 2024), read there because swift.com answered every request with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-30
sources.said: Name of country: Yemen | IBAN prefix country code (ISO 3166): YE | BBAN structure: 4!a4!n18!c | BBAN length: 26 | Bank identifier position within the BBAN: 1-4 | Branch identifier position within the BBAN: 5-8 | IBAN structure: YE2!n4!a4!n18!c | IBAN length: 30 | IBAN electronic format example: YE15CBYE0001018861234567891234
